parameters.name: AuditLogStatus
parameters.description:
The status of SQL audit. Valid values:

*   **on**: SQL audit is enabled.
*   **off**: SQL audit is disabled.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb modify-audit-log-config --db-cluster-id am-t4nj8619bz2w30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --audit-log-status on --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
